interpretation_limitations: A sum near 1,440 is arithmetic compatibility, not proof of verified 24-hour coverage.
Recorded sleep rows are not validated actual minutes asleep; sleep and activity interval semantics may differ or overlap.
A short recorded activity total does not establish device non-wear or explain why minutes are absent.
The April 11-12 exclusions are sensitivity checks only; primary matched-date results retain all dates.
No inferential p-values are calculated; repeated days and small participant-specific samples remain descriptive.
method: Sum very_active_minutes + fairly_active_minutes + lightly_active_minutes + sedentary_minutes, verify against the stored Phase 2 total, then add the recorded rows in one unique eligible sleep episode. Difference is combined minus 1,440.
question: Do four recorded activity-minute fields plus uniquely matched sleep-log row counts sum to 1,440?
